definitions.explanation: A smooth, jiggly custard dessert topped with caramel sauce. One of the most popular everyday desserts in Japan.

examples.japanese: プリン⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}った→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧。
⟦コンビニ→コンビニ：01081_konbini⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧プリン⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{意外|いがい}→意外：12741_igai⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧おいしい。
examples.english: Convenience store pudding is surprisingly good.

examples.japanese: {子|こ}ども⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{頃|ころ}、⟦{母|はは}→母：00549_haha⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{作|つく}って→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧⟦くれた→くれる：00724_kureru⟧プリン⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{一番|いちばん}→一番：01140_ichiban⟧⟦{好|す}き→好き：02355_suki⟧だった。
examples.english: When I was a child, the pudding my mother made for me was my favorite.

notes:
USAGE:
In Japan, プリン specifically refers to custard pudding (creme caramel), not the broader English meaning of "pudding." It is widely available at convenience stores, supermarkets, and bakeries, and is one of the most beloved desserts across all ages.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{焼|や}き→焼く：01123_yaku⟧プリン (baked pudding)
- プリンアラモード (pudding a la mode)
- {固|かた}め⟦の→の：09472_no⟧プリン (firm pudding)
- なめらかプリン (smooth pudding)
- プリン⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}る→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧ (make pudding)

ETYMOLOGY:
From English "pudding," with the pronunciation adapted to Japanese phonology.
